visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen introduction showing three different dishes inspired by the Chiikawa character 'Hachiware'. A hand enters the frame from the right. (2) The scene transitions to a kitchen setting where a woman is cooking small sausages in a red pan over a blue gas flame. She then pours a packet of ready-made tomato pasta into a ceramic bowl. (3) The sausages are placed on top of the pasta. A brief cartoon illustration of the dish appears before showing the finished real-world meal. (4) In a living room, a young woman with bangs and a blue Chiikawa t-shirt tastes the pasta. She has a neutral reaction and then uses a tissue from a branded box to wipe her mouth. (5) The next phase shows the preparation of 'wilted pea shoots with mushroom chocolates'. The woman adds salt to green pea shoots in a container and then arranges mushroom-shaped chocolate snacks on top. (6) A cartoon graphic of the dish is shown, followed by the finished product on a white plate. (7) The woman tastes the vegetable and chocolate combination, displaying a visible expression of disgust and confusion. (8) She reaches for a pink tissue box featuring Chiikawa characters to wipe her hands and mouth. (9) Preparation of the third dish involves tofu noodles and tangerine segments. The woman peels a tangerine and arranges the slices over cold tofu noodles in a bowl. (10) A cartoon comparison is shown, then the final dish is presented with ice cubes around the noodles. (11) The woman takes a hesitant bite of the tangerine noodles, wipes her mouth again, and walks away through a doorway into a hallway. (12) The video shifts to a product showcase. The woman holds several packs of 'Delight x Chiikawa' three-ply tissues in front of a neutral indoor background. (13) She demonstrates using the tissue to wipe her nose, highlighting the softness. (14) Various scenes show the product in different locations: a bathroom shelf, a bedroom nightstand, and on a table next to a ginger cat. The woman is seen petting the cat. (15) Close-up shots demonstrate the thickness and durability of the tissue as she pulls on it with her hands. (16) The woman is seen outdoors in front of a 7-Eleven store, holding large multi-packs of the branded tissues and smiling. (17) The final shot shows her back indoors, wiping her eyes with a tissue while looking at a cartoon overlay, finishing her meal.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic pop track. A female voice provides an upbeat greeting. A sharp mechanical click is heard as the gas stove is lit, followed by the steady sizzle of frying oil. (2) A whoosh sound effect marks a transition. The BGM maintains its bright texture. Sound of dry pasta hitting a ceramic bowl with a subtle clatter. (3) A ding sound effect signals the 'completion' of the first dish. The narrator's tone is casual and descriptive. (4) Percussive sounds of a fork clinking against a bowl during the tasting scene. A brief rustling sound follows as a tissue is pulled from a box. (5) New phase triggered by the sound of salt being sprinkled into a plastic container. The BGM remains consistent. (6) A cartoonish 'pop' sound effect occurs when the chocolate snacks are placed on the vegetables. (7) During the tasting of the chocolate dish, a comical sliding sound effect reflects the narrator's discomfort. (8) A loud rustle of plastic packaging is heard as a multi-pack of tissues is shown. (9) Sound of water splashing or draining as the tofu noodles are prepared. The narrator's voice becomes more promotional and enthusiastic. (10) A soft 'mew' from a cat is audible in the background as the narrator discusses home use. (11) Repeated sounds of tissue paper being crinkled and pulled to emphasize its durability. (12) Ambient outdoor traffic hum is faintly heard during the 7-Eleven storefront shot. (13) The video concludes with a final comical sound effect as the narrator jokingly laments the taste of the creative dishes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experiment -> Product Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a popular anime-themed food challenge (recreating weird recipes from Chiikawa) to grab attention, which then shifts into a promotional advertisement for 'Delight x Chiikawa' tissues. The creator emphasizes the necessity of tissues when trying 'strange' food and highlights the product's features like softness and durability.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator holds the product, describes its physical attributes (3-ply, softness), mentions a specific retail availability (7-Eleven), and uses on-screen slogans promoting the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges fan culture (Chiikawa) with a household product through a 'recreation' narrative. The orange cat adds a lifestyle appeal.
